description:
When a person feels love, a "bird" is born in person heart. Bianca can remove this "bird", she is a "Bird Collector". This is her collection of tragic romances and their "birds".

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/totnwlqrk/), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/bird_collector), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1746016335), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_collector_wz), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6702215), [Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/episode/none?ind=5211), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60762344)
